strong_proposal.title: AI-Based Cloudburst Early Warning System for KPK
strong_proposal.problem_statement: KPK faces devastating cloudburst events annually with no AI-based early warning system. PMD ground stations are absent in high-risk mountainous districts.
strong_proposal.technical_description: ConvLSTM model trained on NASA GPM-IMERG satellite data and ERA5 atmospheric variables. FastAPI backend. React dashboard. Deployed on AWS.
strong_proposal.technology_stack: Python, TensorFlow, FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL, AWS

ethics_risk_proposal.title: AI Facial Recognition Attendance and Campus Monitoring System
ethics_risk_proposal.problem_statement: Universities need automated attendance and behavior monitoring for students across campus gates and classrooms.
ethics_risk_proposal.technical_description: The system uses facial recognition on CCTV streams, stores biometric templates, and flags suspicious student movement in real time through an admin dashboard.
ethics_risk_proposal.technology_stack: Python, OpenCV, FaceNet, FastAPI, React, PostgreSQL
